message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.1.9 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

Version 2.1.9 makes Auto Captions more accurate, adds Translate To English, and runs captions fully on your own machine.

*(Install over your current version with your ZXP installer and restart Premiere Pro once to apply the update.)*

♦️ **Auto Captions**
* **No More Missing Sentences:** Music or noise under the voice no longer makes whole sentences disappear.
* **Better Language Detection:** It listens to several parts of the clip, not just the first 30 seconds.
* **Hinglish:** Comes out in Roman letters with English words kept in English, and is much more accurate.
* **Translate To English:** Offline, with Large V3 or Medium.

♦️ **Models**
* **Shorter List:** Large V3 Turbo, Large V3 and Medium, in Auto Captions and in the Silence tab (Retakes and Filler Cleanup). If you had picked a removed model, it switches to one you already have. Nothing new downloads unless you choose to.
* **Captions On Your Machine:** Flex AI cloud captions are off for now, so no credits are used. The Flex AI engine for Retakes is still there.
